dedupe_keys.name: dataset for developing deep learning models to assess crack width and self healing progress in concrete

description: Dataset for developing deep learning models to assess crack width and self-healing progress in concrete is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Jacek Jakubowski et al. The presented dataset comes from an experimental study on the autogenous self-healing of high-strength concrete and the development of deep learning metasensor for crack width assessment and self-healing evaluation. Concrete specimens were prepared, matured, cracked, and exposed to self-healing. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. Formats: CSV, GeoTIFF, Image, ZIP. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
